slides.texte_overlay:
If you're a man in your 20s,
learn these 10 TRUTHS early
1. Your health is your first wealth. 2. Your habits matter more than your goals. Small daily actions decide where you'll be at 30.
3. Your parents won't be around forever. Call them. 4. Real friends are rare. Keep the few who show up when life gets hard.
5. Skills pay more than degrees over time. 6. Your phone is stealing your best hours. Take some of them back every day.
7. Saying no protects your future. 8. Most worries never happen. Deal with today and let tomorrow come. Breathe.
9. Never stop learning. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and it keeps me growing long after school ended.
slides.texte_sophia: 9. I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. It keeps me growing long after school ended.

slides.texte_overlay: 10. You're allowed to start over. A new city, a new job, a new habit. Your 20s are for trying, failing and trying again.
Save this and read it again in a year. You'll be surprised how much these truths change the way you live. Share it.
